property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v lengths, transfer returns true and does not consume remaining gas via silent failure: if all external calls to caddress succeed, transfer returns true; if any external call fails, transfer reverts.
If transfer is called with non-empty _tos and matching v lengths, then it either returns true (no revert) or it reverts; when it returns, the returned value is true.
If transfer is called with non-empty _tos and matching v lengths, then it never returns false — it either reverts or returns true.
When called with non-empty _tos and v of equal length, transfer either reverts or returns true (it never successfully returns false).
